text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr showed a brilliant 
performance in the Sprinters Stakes. After 
the race, she comes face-to-face with 
Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio says that after being shown a 
race like that, she could never give up on 
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she proposed they settle things at 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—the race that had 
eluded the two "Emperors" they both 
idolized.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yamanin Zephyr's ultimate goal was 
set for next year's Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
And precisely because of that—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we must conquer the Sprint/Mile 
route. The next target is the Mile 
Championship.
